projects.query: official API 5CT hydrostatic test pressure pipe manufacturer specification 120 MPa hydrostatic tester
projects.finding: API confirms Specification 5CT and Technical Report 5C3 are the governing standards family; the project must derive test pressure from product/grade/end configuration rather than treating 120 MPa machine capacity as the universal acceptance pressure.
projects.coverage_gap: Licensed standard clauses and the exact pipe grade, dimensions, end configuration and purchaser agreement remain required.

projects.query: official can necking machine cans per minute manufacturer necker specifications
projects.finding: Official manufacturer pages show that necker throughput spans materially different equipment classes: approximately 120 CPM for some general can machines, 600-800 CPM for welded food-can machines, and 2400-3600 CPM for high-speed two-piece lines. Quotations are not comparable until can type, diameter/height, necking stages and auxiliary scope are normalized.
projects.coverage_gap: The target can geometry, material, operations and FAT sustained-rate definition must be bound to each quotation.

projects.query: site:trade.gov pro forma invoice required information official export documentation
projects.finding: The International Trade Administration lists seller and buyer identity, item description, unit and total prices, weights/dimensions, Incoterm and delivery point, payment terms, estimated shipping date and validity date as core pro-forma fields.
projects.coverage_gap: The actual seller identity, quantities, prices and agreed commercial terms are transaction evidence and cannot be invented.
